sloka: त्वया लोकास्त्रयः क्रान्ताः पुराणे विक्रमैस्त्रिभिः ।महेन्द्रश्च कृतो राजा बलिं बद्ध्वा महासुरम् ।। ६.१२०.२८ ।।
transliteration: tvayā lokāstrayaḥ krāntāḥ purāṇe vikramaistribhiḥ ।mahendraśca kṛto rājā baliṁ baddhvā mahāsuram ।। 6.120.28 ।।

translations.english: "Sita is goddess Lakshmi while you are Vishnu. You are Krishna. You are the Lord of created beings. In order to put an end to Ravana, you entered the mortal body on earth."
